evidence.reason: declared_inventory reads `git ls-tree -r --name-only` output with `splitlines()` and only keeps lines beginning with `TEMPLATE_DIR`. Git's default pathname quoting wraps non-ASCII names in quotes and octal-escapes them, so an undeclared file such as `crq-tick-copy-é.timer` does not start with the template directory prefix and is silently omitted from `committed`, bypassing the inventory refusal. Reading NUL-delimited bytes with `-z` is the smallest compatible fix.
